name: Brothers in Arms
description: Also called KE. Points come only from killing enemy troops or losing your own troops, so it is one of the deadliest events.
frequency: Once a month, in the week of the normal Sunfire Castle battle.
duration: Friday 00:00 UTC to Sunday 00:00 UTC (2 days).

phases.name: Start
phases.description: Friday 00:00 UTC. The event begins and gatherings reset. The game gives 24 hours of notice.

phases.name: Sunfire Castle battle
phases.description: The normal Sunfire Castle battle happens during the event window.

rewards.name: Ranking rewards
rewards.note: Given to the top 100 chiefs with 4,000 or more points. Troop kills and losses give 1 to 15 points depending on troop level.

tips: Join the Sunfire Castle battle to gain points.
Gathering during the event makes you a target. Check gatherings around alliances at the Friday 00:00 UTC reset.
Use a farm account or friendly battles if you do not want to take part.
